currentMpv2Flow.balanceProtocol: Current MPV2 uses a single-leg eyes-open multi-attempt protocol with rest/use-best branches, not the full V2.1 balance ladder.

addedCueKeys.script: Balance check. Keep support within easy reach. I will guide each stance.
Single-leg. Stand on your selected leg and lift the other foot slightly.
Chair stand. Sit in the middle of a sturdy chair, side-on to the phone.
Cross your arms. When I say go, stand fully and sit with control until I say time.
Check-up complete. Your results are ready.
Slowly fold from your hips and reach toward the floor. Hold there until I say stand tall.
Raise your left arm as high as comfortable. Hold there until I say relax.
Raise your right arm as high as comfortable. Hold there until I say relax.
Turn so your left side is nearest the phone.
Turn so your right side is nearest the phone.
You're set.
Complete.
That attempt is saved.
Lift your other foot when you're ready. This attempt can last up to 45 seconds.
Balance check complete.
You completed the full 45-second hold.
You can start the next attempt when you're ready.
You're ready for the next attempt.
Rest now. You can start again after 30 seconds, or use your best result.
Tracking was interrupted, so this attempt will not count. Return to the setup position and we'll try again.
Your best hold is saved.
Sit back down. The 30-second check starts after the countdown.
Try one practice stand. This one will not count.
Movement Profile Check-Up. I will guide each capture and save what the camera can measure.
Forward reach saved.
Forward reach was not measured. Your main Check-Up is saved.
Tracking was interrupted. Lower your arm, return to the setup position, and we'll try once more.
Let's try that again.
Time.
Pause. Return to the setup position.
You're back in position. We'll restart.
